fusions.name: Herd Pile-On
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: deals 22 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max +32%).

fusions.name: Warmth Thief
fusions.desc: Swats every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Herd Grooming
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Fighting beside others pays: +10% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.

fusions.name: Fed and Rested
fusions.desc: Each time you are healed, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 4 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
